normalized_params.content:
#!/bin/sh
# 验收探针：证明自己是谁、能不能写特权路径。
# 写证据失败就当场 exit 3：写不出证据却回 0，等于让三条身份断言拿到空文件而静默通过。
id -un > "/var/tmp/upanel-accept-p12-4/probe/whoami.txt" || exit 3
id -u >> "/var/tmp/upanel-accept-p12-4/probe/whoami.txt" || exit 3
id -nG > "/var/tmp/upanel-accept-p12-4/probe/groups.txt" || exit 3
touch /etc/p12-4-should-fail 2>"/var/tmp/upanel-accept-p12-4/probe/etc-write.err"
echo "rc=$?" >> "/var/tmp/upanel-accept-p12-4/probe/etc-write.err"
echo probe-done
normalized_params.name: p12-4 探针 ae06b65e

impacts.description: 脚本将以 upanel-shell 身份运行，永远不获得 root
